power_attack.name: Power Attack
power_attack.description: Trade melee attack bonus for melee damage (1:1 one-handed, 1:2 two-handed).

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.description: Take an immediate extra melee attack after dropping a foe to 0 HP or below.

combat_reflexes.name: Combat Reflexes
combat_reflexes.description: Make additional Attacks of Opportunity equal to your DEX modifier and make AoOs while flat-footed.

blind_fight.name: Blind-Fight
blind_fight.description: Re-roll miss chance percentiles caused by concealment once.

weapon_focus_bite.name: Weapon Focus (Bite)
weapon_focus_bite.description: +1 bonus on attack rolls with bite attacks.

weapon_focus_greatclub.name: Weapon Focus (Greatclub)
weapon_focus_greatclub.description: +1 bonus on attack rolls with a greatclub.

alertness.name: Alertness
alertness.description: +2 bonus on Listen and Spot checks.

track.name: Track
track.description: Use Survival checks to follow tracks.
